summaryBullets: See product differences before comparison tools and supporting documents.
Get current connection advice when rates are unavailable, without guessing why loading failed.
Use clearer labels for rate conditions, eligibility, watched rates and document coverage.
Find filter options and lenders more easily, and see calculator prompts only after you use a field.
Improve dependency security, search responsiveness and performance-audit reliability.

bullets.text: Comparison differences now appear before terms, calculators and published product details.
The unavailable-data screen follows network changes immediately and keeps newer connection information when an earlier check finishes late.
Online loading failures use neutral advice; offline advice appears only when the device reports no connectivity.
Saved products use a consistent star icon, and product disclosures use clearer wording.
Filter groups show every option behind “Show all” instead of dropping options after 24, and the lender list can be searched.
The rate check calculator flags an empty field only after you leave it; invalid values are still flagged straight away.
Snackbar actions and the filter close button meet the 48 dp touch-target minimum, and Settings and calculator headings use sentence case.
Update dependencies and protect review and release tooling from unsafe code or shell interpretation.
Search remains responsive while suitability information loads, with more reliable recovery after delayed data.
Performance audits preserve diagnostic evidence, improve startup and navigation handling, and avoid redundant work.
